techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts when passwords are unknown or when password hashes are obtained.
techniques.detection: Monitor for many failed authentication attempts across multiple accounts.
techniques.mitigation: Enforce account lockouts, multi-factor authentication, and rate limiting.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, or Defense Evasion.
techniques.detection: Monitor for unusual account usage, such as logins from new geographic locations.
techniques.mitigation: Use multi-factor authentication and monitor for anomalous login behavior.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to exploit a weakness in an Internet-facing computer or program using software, data, or commands.
techniques.detection: Monitor application logs for anomalous requests and injection patterns.
techniques.mitigation: Apply input validation, parameterized queries, and web application firewalls.

techniques.name: Supply Chain Compromise
techniques.description: Adversaries may manipulate products or product delivery mechanisms prior to receipt by a final consumer.
techniques.detection: Monitor dependency resolution and build-time behavior for unexpected changes.
techniques.mitigation: Pin dependency versions, verify package integrity, and scan for malicious packages.

techniques.name: Network Service Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts, including those that may be vulnerable.
techniques.detection: Monitor for scanning activity such as connections to many ports from a single source.
techniques.mitigation: Restrict network access and use network segmentation.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.description: Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over an existing command and control channel.
techniques.detection: Monitor for large data transfers or unusual query patterns returning large result sets.
techniques.mitigation: Monitor and restrict outbound data transfers; detect unusual bulk reads.

techniques.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
techniques.description: Adversaries may exploit software vulnerabilities to attempt to elevate privileges.
techniques.detection: Monitor for unexpected privilege changes or use of admin-level accounts.
techniques.mitigation: Keep systems patched; enforce least privilege.
